title: Cords of Love
old_p1: Heavenly Father told how He led His people. “I drew them with cords of a man,” He said, “with bands of love.”
Cords and bands are ropes. Back then, people used ropes to lead their animals every day. But Heavenly Father did not pull hard. His cords were love, like arms around you, guiding you home.
old_p2: A yoke is a heavy wooden bar that farm animals wore to pull a load. Farmers saw them all the time. Heavenly Father said He was like someone lifting that heavy yoke off.
Then He set food before them so they could eat. Kindness, and more kindness.
Heavenly Father draws you with love, too. Tonight, feel how His kindness makes your heart want to come near.
p1: The prophet Hosea’s people had wandered away from Heavenly Father. So Heavenly Father told them how much He still loved them.
Long ago, farmers used ropes to lead their animals. Heavenly Father said, “I drew them with bands of love.” Bands are like soft ropes. To draw means to gently pull someone close.
Heavenly Father does not yank or push. He gently pulls us close with love.
p2: Some farm animals wore a yoke. A yoke is a heavy wooden bar for pulling big loads. Heavenly Father said He was like a kind farmer. He lifts the heavy yoke off. Then He sets down food for the animal to eat.
Heavenly Father helps when things feel heavy. Tonight you can tell Him what felt heavy today. Then let Him help you feel light and loved.
